svg.text: Hertz: borrowed buffers that report when they are safe to reuse
The agent adds borrowed-buffer writes to the CloudWeGo Hertz HTTP framework. Every submitted buffer gets one lease that settles exactly once, after the bytes
are copied, flushed, failed or abandoned, while the bytes on the wire stay what Hertz sends today.
offline container, 2 CPUs, 8 GB, up to 12 hours
same wire output, request targets and error
the collected diff of /app is what gets graded

lease.Result().State == LeasePending: buf still belongs to Hertz
chunk size line, then buf itself, not a copy
Done() closes; Result() = {LeaseReleased, Bytes: 4096}: buf may be reused
if the flush fails instead: {LeaseFailed, Bytes affected, Err: *LeaseError wrapping the cause}
FinalizeCompletion(): one OutputCompletion for all chunks, terminal framing, trailers and the final flush
Each lease reaches exactly one terminal state, released, failed or abandoned, and later flushes cannot change it.
The bytes on the wire are the same as the existing chunked writer sends today.
ONE BORROWED CHUNK, FROM SUBMISSION TO ITS SINGLE RESULT
